## Daily Filing Check 
Runs the workflow once every day and fetches the latest SEC filings for the companies being monitored.

## Filter New Filings
Filters the SEC results to keep only 10-K and 10-Q filings, then checks Google Sheets to identify whether the filing has already been processed.

## Prepare Filing Data
Combines the required filing information from different workflow branches and prepares clean filing metadata for the next processing steps.

## Extract Filing Content
Fetches the complete SEC filing document and extracts the important Risk Factors and MD&A sections needed for sentiment and risk analysis.

## Prepare AI Analysis
Combines filing metadata with the extracted content and prepares the relevant information in a structured format that can be sent to the AI model.

## Analyze Filing
Uses AI to analyze the filing, identify sentiment and risk levels, summarize key risks, evaluate the business outlook, and extract important financial highlights.

## Save & Notify
Stores the completed filing analysis in Google Sheets and sends a concise Slack notification containing the important sentiment, risk, business, and financial insights.

# SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q Sentiment with OpenAI, Sheets & Slack

This n8n workflow automatically checks SEC EDGAR for the latest **10-K or 10-Q filing**, downloads the filing document, extracts the **Risk Factors** and **Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A)** sections, sends relevant filing content to **OpenAI** for sentiment and risk analysis, saves the result in **Google Sheets**, and sends a summary alert to **Slack**. The workflow also checks the filing's accession number to help prevent processing the same filing multiple times.

## Setup Steps

- Create an n8n workflow and add a Schedule Trigger for the required daily execution time.
- Configure the SEC EDGAR HTTP Request to retrieve recent company filings.
- Add a Code node to filter only 10-K and 10-Q filing types.
Connect Google Sheets and configure it to check existing accession numbers.
- Add an IF node to identify whether the filing is new or already processed.
- Configure the required Merge and Code nodes to prepare the filing metadata.
- Add an HTTP Request to fetch the complete SEC filing document.
- Extract the Risk Factors and MD&A sections using a Code node.
- Prepare the extracted filing content and metadata for the AI model.
- Configure the AI model with a structured prompt for sentiment and risk analysis.
- Format the AI response into consistent JSON fields.
Configure Google Sheets to append the analysis as a new row.
- Configure Slack credentials and create the filing alert message.
- Test the complete workflow with a real SEC filing.
Verify that the data is correctly saved in Sheets and the Slack notification is received.
